## Atkore Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend


04/30/2026


Download (opens in new window)


HARVEY, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


The Board of Directors of Atkore Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: ATKR), a leading manufacturer of electrical products for commercial, industrial, data center, and solar applications, today declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.33 per share of common stock payable on May 29, 2026, to stockholders of record on May 19, 2026.


**About Atkore Inc.**


Atkore is a leading manufacturer of electrical products for commercial, industrial, data center, and solar applications. With 5,400 employees and $2.9B in sales in fiscal year 2025, we deliver sustainable solutions to meet the growing demands of electrification and digital transformation. To learn more, please visit[www.atkore.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.atkore.com&esheet=54525912&newsitemid=20260430498393&lan=en-US&anchor=www.atkore.com&index=1&md5=443ec458cc304ed17be1f89a30a39c88) .


**Dissemination of Company Information**


Atkore intends to make future announcements regarding company developments and financial performance through its website,[www.atkore.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.atkore.com&esheet=54525912&newsitemid=20260430498393&lan=en-US&anchor=www.atkore.com&index=2&md5=e272c324ab4a1f1f3f4060bc346a32e9) , as well as through press releases, filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, conference calls, media broadcasts, and webcasts.
